newsitem.title: UK: NWE naphtha eases slightly in moribund market.
newsitem.headline: NWE naphtha eases slightly in moribund market.

text.p: NWE Naphtha eased slightly on the back of weaker crude futures in a moribund market, traders said.
Naphtha swaps eased with crude futures. June paper was assessed at $187.50/$188.50 and July paper at around $187.75/$189.50 for July.
Traders said the market was very quiet with much of Germany extending Thursday's regional Corpus Christi holiday into the weekend.
Full-range cargoes were assessed around $186/$189 a tonne cif NWE for June delivery and July delivery material was seen at a $1-$2 premium above there.
